title.raw: Make Firefox feel more like home

subtitle.raw: Answer a few questions and we’ll recommend extensions to enhance your use of Firefox.
Extensions are tiny apps that let you customize Firefox. They can power up your privacy, enhance productivity, change the way Firefox looks, and so much more.
Thank you for using Firefox, the only major browser backed by a non-profit. With your support, we’re working to make the internet safer and more accessible for everyone.
Grab bookmarks, passwords, and more everywhere you’re signed in to Firefox. Plus, your data is encrypted so only you can see it.
Firefox’s standard privacy setting includes Total Cookie Protection, which keeps cookies locked to the site you’re on. This protects you from tracking that follows you across the web.
